audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Cassiopeia at Level 1 and at 2+ items while the page's own text calls Level 1 'a coinflip' and says a fully-stacked drain-tank Singed 'reclaims this lane'. Levels 4-5 and First item were Skill while the text says your ramp beats his sustain there.
audit.why: Lane difficulty is a key point and the chart disagreed with its own why-text in four stages.
audit.corrected: Skill / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill across both layers.
sources: existing whys[] and late text on the same entry

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as if only Cassiopeia spikes there. Singed's own 6 spike — Insanity Potion — was never mentioned.
audit.why: Power spikes are a key point, and his 6 changes your sustain, not just his stats.
audit.corrected: Insanity Potion (100s) named at Level 6 with its Grievous Wounds effect; Fling 10s at rank 1 to 8s maxed and Mega Adhesive 17s added to the cooldown text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was repeatedly labelled W — it is E; W is Mega Adhesive. The page never said Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which halves the heal on Twin Fang, and never said a Fling that lands a target inside Mega Adhesive roots them.
audit.why: Point 4 is the most important point. Your entire sustain in this lane is Twin Fang's heal, and his ult turns it off; the Fling-into-goo root is the setup that kills you.
audit.corrected: Fling relabelled (E); Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds stated and tied to burst-before-he-drinks sequencing; Fling-into-Mega-Adhesive root stated. The existing (correct) note that Miasma's grounding does nothing to a targeted Fling was left in place.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (E Fling, W Mega Adhesive, R antiHeal)

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze catches his run-down: stun him as he closes to Fling you or as he tries to walk away, then ramp E to convert the trade into a kill.
edits.after: Both ults land at 6: Insanity Potion has his trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving Twin Fang's heal — stun his run-down with Petrifying Gaze before he drinks.

edits.before: Fling (W) you onto his Poison Trail, then chase you down with his huge passive bonus move speed
edits.after: Fling (E) you onto his Poison Trail and Mega Adhesive, where the landing roots you, then run you down

edits.before: Force a fight near his Mega Adhesive or tower so he Flings you in and outruns your kite
edits.after: Pop Insanity Potion (100s) so his trail's Grievous Wounds cuts the Twin Fang heal you rely on

edits.before: You have one ability and no poison primed, and his W-Fling onto the trail punishes any step-up — last-hit safe and wait for your level-2 combo.
edits.after: You have one ability and no poison primed, and his Fling (E) onto the trail punishes any step-up — last-hit safe and wait for your level-2 combo.

edits.before: This is your window. Ranks in Q and E mean every trade is a chain of Twin Fangs on a poisoned target, and your passive move speed plus Q's speed buff let you sit just outside his Fling range while he eats poison ticks. Use W to slow him and keep poison rolling so E keeps refunding — not to lock him down, since he has no dash to ground. At 6, hold Petrifying Gaze for the moment he closes to Fling you or turns to run — stun him and the won trade becomes a kill. Respect his sustain: he heals through chip, so commit your E ramp in bursts, not idle pokes.
edits.after: This is your window. Ranks in Q and E mean every trade is a chain of Twin Fang casts on a poisoned target, and your passive move speed plus Q's speed buff let you sit outside his 125-range Fling while he eats poison ticks. Fling is 10s at rank 1 — step in the moment it is spent, never before. Use W to slow him and keep poison rolling so E keeps refunding, not to lock him down, since he has no dash to ground. At 6 hold Petrifying Gaze for his Fling commit, and spend your E ramp in bursts before Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cuts the heal.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. It governs your forward steps. - W Miasma spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Singed Fling (E): matchup-defining — 10s at rank 1, 8s maxed; never step inside 125 range while it is up. - Mega Adhesive (17s) roots you if he Flings you into it. - W Miasma spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold R for his Fling commit.

notes: Fling was mislabelled W across this entry; only the strings I edited are corrected — grep the rest of cassiopeia/singed content for 'Fling (W)'. full.diff is 'HARD' while diffRating is 5.5/10 and the breakdown says 'Even matchup'; left alone in case diff is a controlled enum.
